label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is a True Positive. User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') is stored in 'param' and passed directly to response.sendRedirect(param) on line 21. Although execution is gated by an IP check (line 20), this does not sanitize the input. Any attacker with an IP address starting with '10.' can control the redirect destination, creating a path injection/open redirect vulnerability. The resolved sink value is the unvalidated user input 'param'.

evidence.note: User input 'param' retrieved from request and used directly in sendRedirect sink without sanitization.
